image_description: The image displays a collection of bicycle components, specifically disc brake rotors and calipers, arranged on a wooden surface. There are two distinct rotor assemblies visible: one on the left with a silver metallic finish and a red/white sticker, and one on the right with yellow accents. Black hydraulic hoses connect the calipers to the rest of the assembly. The background is a textured wood grain.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Circular metal rotor (disc), notably larger in diameter than its thickness.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both assemblies feature large, thin, circular metallic discs consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caliper is cast metal mounted over rotor edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Caliper mechanisms are clearly visible clamped onto the outer edges of the rotors.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rotor is mounted to wheel hub with visible lug bolt pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotors appear to be detached from a wheel or are mounted on adapters that obscure the standard automotive-style lug bolt pattern; bicycle mounts (6-bolt or centerlock) are not clearly resolved as 'lug bolts' in the traditional sense, and the view is cluttered.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rotor is ventilated (two plates with cooling fins) or solid.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotors show complex cutout patterns typical of bicycle ventilated or floating disc designs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Brake pads are rectangular friction material blocks pressing against rotor faces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The caliper housing structure implies the presence of pads, though the pads themselves are largely internal/occluded by the caliper body, the functional assembly is present.
Black flexible tubing (hydraulic lines) is clearly connected to the caliper bodies.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface shows machined concentric grooves or cross-drilled holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotors exhibit intricate cutouts and machining marks consistent with braking surfaces.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface exhibits heat discoloration (blue/brown tint) from use.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotors appear relatively clean and new; there is no significant blueing or brown heat staining visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caliper is cast aluminum or iron.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The calipers have the visual texture and sheen of cast metal (likely aluminum for bicycle applications).

artifact_observations.location: Stickers on the left rotor and caliper
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the red/white sticker on the left caliper is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated gibberish rather than a clear brand logo.

artifact_observations.location: Center of the image where hoses and rotors overlap
